summary_data.why_matters: **로봇 학습 파이프라인이 단일 물리 엔진 종속에서 벗어나 다중 솔버·백엔드를 선택적으로 조합하는 모듈형 구조로 전환**되는 것은 시뮬레이션 기반 RL 워크플로우의 설치·실행 장벽을 낮추는 구조적 변화다. 이는 Isaac Sim 풀스택 없이도 경량 학습 루프를 구성할 수 있게 하여, 개발자 저변 확대와 클라우드/분산 학습 효율화에 영향을 줄 수 있다.
summary_data.subject_angle: **NVIDIA는 Isaac Sim을 선택적 옵션으로 두고 Warp-native 경량 백엔드(Newton, OV Libraries)를 전면에 내세워 Isaac 생태계의 진입장벽을 낮추는 전략**을 취하고 있으며, 이는 자체 생태계(Warp, CUDA) 의존도는 유지하면서 외부 물리 엔진(MuJoCo 등)과의 상호운용성을 넓히는 포지셔닝으로 읽힌다.
summary_data.focus_angle: 자율주행·휴머노이드 로봇 OEM 입장에서는 Kit-less 구조로 무거운 Isaac Sim 설치 없이도 강화학습 파이프라인을 구축할 수 있어, **대규모 분산 학습 환경에서의 비용·인프라 부담이 줄고 다양한 물리 시뮬레이션(변형체·입자 포함) 기반 휴머노이드 조작 학습이 용이해질 수 있다**. 다만 본문에 구체적 OEM 적용 사례나 자율주행 적용 일정은 언급되지 않아 산업 적용 시점은 미확인이다.

cards.body: Isaac Lab 3.0 Isaac Lab 3.0 is now generally available. v3.0.0 is the official Isaac Lab 3.0 release and the recommended baseline for new projects and migrations from Isaac Lab 2.x. Isaac Lab 3.0 establishes the foundation for the next generation of robot learning in Isaac Lab: one task API across multiple physics, rendering, and visualization backends; kit-less execution with Newton and OV library backends; Warp-native data paths; and unified workflows from installation through training, evaluation, and deployment. Newton is a Warp-native physics backend with multiple solver paths, including MuJoCo-Warp, VBD, and MPM. It lets Isaac Lab support rigid bodies, deformables, and particles without tying tasks to one physics engine. OV Libraries provide OVPhysX for PhysX and OVRTX for RTX rendering as standalone libraries. Isaac Sim remains the complete path when a workflow needs the full PhysX/RTX stack, ROS bridge, XR, livestreaming, or Kit tooling, but now fully optional. MicroDuck rendering VBD cable insertion MPM liquid pouring One task API; install and run only the capabilities you need. This release targets Isaac Sim 6.2, Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.11 with CUDA 13.0, NVIDIA Warp 1.17, Newton 1.6.1, and RSL-RL 5.5.1. cards.body: Nvidia is increasing its investments in Europe's artificial intelligence sector, unveiling plans to back four German startups as the country pushes to strengthen its position in industrial AI. The investments are part of the U.S. chipmaker's nearly $10 billion commitment to invest in companies, universities and research institutions across Europe, as announced at the Invest in Germany Summit in Berlin on Monday. The four startups are Agile Robots, Avelios Medical, Mirelo and Reflex Aerospace. However, Nvidia did not disclose the size of the planned investments. Agile Robots develops AI-powered robots for manufacturing, logistics and healthcare, while Avelios Medical builds AI-powered hospital management software. Mirelo develops AI models that generate audio for videos, while Reflex Aerospace designs and builds satellites. The announcement comes as Germany seeks to accelerate AI adoption across its industrial sector, with Chancellor Friedrich Merz saying the country aims to become a leader in integrating AI into key sectors. Merz, who described the technology as a major opportunity for the country's economy, named manufacturing, machinery and the automotive industry for integrating AI. He also urged Germany's small- and medium-sized businesses to capitalize on the data they already hold. "Please open your doors for AI to make use of your data," Merz said. "This is a real secret and a real advantage for Germany to make use of all the data which is already available in our companies." Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang echoed Merz's remarks while highlighting Germany's expertise in manufacturing, mathematics and science, saying that AI would strengthen rather than replace the country's industrial capabilities. "AI can only augment your capability, it will not replace your capability," Huang said, describing the technology as a new instrument for businesses. Nvidia is also expanding its collaboration with the German federal government and its "Industry 4.0 Platform," bringing together representatives from government, industry, research and trade associations, to accelerate the adoption of industrial AI. On Monday, the government signed a joint declaration of intent with Nvidia to advance AI models for industrial applications. Earlier in the day, Siemens had also announced new AI solutions developed with Nvidia at its factory in Erlangen, Germany. Siemens said the technologies could reduce engineering work involved in preparing production by up to 85%, while AI-powered production planning could cut costs by as much as 20%. Huang had also visited France last week, where he announced investments in four French startups and met with French President Emmanuel Macron to discuss AI development. The Nvidia boss is scheduled to deliver a keynote address in Berlin on Wednesday.

cards.body: Chinese technology giants ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have reportedly spent over $35 billion on orders for more than 3 million Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 workstation GPUs. The huge order for the RTX Pro 5500, fully compliant with U.S. restrictions on exports of AI-capable GPUs to China, is reportedly far beyond Nvidia's planned production for this card. As a result, Nvidia has, according to sources who spoke to Reuters , told its customers that it isn't in a position to fill the orders as it far outstrips its planned production for this GPU. Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft) The data center cooling state of play The custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the price GTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this year Demand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsible The RTX Pro 5500 is a workstation GPU with the same number of CUDA cores as its flagship RTX 5090 GPU, but with 84GB of GDDR7 memory attached, making it a good option for AI applications. The RTX Pro 5500 is a popular choice at the moment for Chinese buyers as exporting it isn't currently restricted by the U.S. government. It's less powerful than the H200 and B300, Nvidia's AI-focused GPUs for the enterprise market, but those GPUs remain either banned or heavily restricted. As China competes with the U.S. in the race to produce newer, better AI models, GPUs like the RTX Pro 5500 continue to be indispensable. The report reveals some interesting data about the Chinese tech firms orders. Two of its sources revealed that the cards are priced at around $11,400 each, reaching a total order value of $35 billion. Meanwhile, another source suggested that Nvidia has informed its partners that it may only be able to deliver enough cards to meet between 5% and 10% of the demand. Meanwhile, Nvidia is reportedly in a position to only produce 3 million RTX Pro 5500 cards globally in 2027. Neither Nvidia nor the three Chinese companies have confirmed any of this on the record. However, an Nvidia spokesman told Reuters that demand from the Chinese market for these chips has faced "unprecedented growth since 2022" since export restrictions were introduced. "U.S. firms continue to be restricted by a combination of outdated U.S. export controls, which cover gaming products released nearly half a decade ago, and China's own limits on U.S. imports." While trade hostility between the U.S. and China shows no sign of abating, demand for Nvidia's GPUs hasn't slowed down, despite U.S. attempts to restrict Nvidia's ability to export to China. Meanwhile, export-restricted Nvidia AI chips continue to reach China despite the restrictions, bypassing the Trump administration's efforts in the process.

summary_data.why_matters: 이 공개는 NVIDIA가 **시뮬레이션 기반 합성데이터(restyling)가 실제 로봇 정책 학습에 얼마나 기여하는지를 정량적으로 검증**하려는 체계적 연구 흐름을 보여준다. LIBERO 벤치마크와 Cosmos3-Nano 생성모델을 결합한 이런 재현 가능한 실험 레시피는 로봇 파운데이션 모델 경쟁에서 데이터 효율성 입증 수단으로 활용될 수 있다.
summary_data.subject_angle: NVIDIA는 Cosmos 월드모델을 **단순 생성모델이 아닌 로봇 정책 학습용 합성데이터 엔진으로 포지셔닝**하며, Cosmos Cookbook 레시피를 통해 Sim-to-Real 성능 향상을 체계적으로 입증하려는 전략을 보인다.
summary_data.focus_angle: 휴머노이드·매니퓰레이션 로봇 OEM 입장에서는 **실제 데모 데이터 부족을 Cosmos 기반 합성 restyling으로 보완**해 조작 정책의 일반화 성능(교란 씬 86.8%)을 확보할 수 있다는 점이 중요하며, 이는 데이터 수집 비용이 큰 자율주행·로봇 암 학습 파이프라인에도 적용 가능한 방법론적 참고 사례가 된다.

headlines.body: AI 추천 뉴스 美서 1200억원 유치한 20대 韓창업가 스타트업 드림랩스 장요엘 대표 엔비디아 출신…'AI 두뇌' 개발 20대 한국인이 미국에서 설립한 스타트업이 창업 3개월 만에 시드 투자로 1200억원 규모의 자금을 유치했다. 미국 샌프란시스코의 드림랩스는 9000만달러(약 1200억원) 규모의 투자를 유치했다고 19일(현지시간) 발표했다. 창업 후 처음으로 투자받은 이번 시드는 미국 벤처캐피털(VC)인 B캐피털이 주도했으며, 국내에선 베이스벤처스가 참여했다. 드림랩스는 엔비디아에서 인공지능(AI) 로봇 개발 프로젝트인 ‘그루트(GR00T)’ 연구를 이끈 장요엘 대표(사진)가 설립한 회사로, 여러 로봇에 공통으로 사용할 수 있는 ‘AI 두뇌’(드림-1)를 개발하고 있다. 드림-1은 사람의 말을 이해하고 주변 상황을 살펴 로봇의 움직임을 결정하도록 하는 기술이다. 드림랩스는 다른 로봇 제조사들도 이 기술을 사용할 수 있도록 ‘드림 API’를 이날 공개했다. 현재 중국 유니트리, 한국 로보티즈 등 20개 이상의 로봇 하드웨어 업체와 협력 중이다. 이번에 유치한 투자금은 AI 개발에 필요한 컴퓨팅 자원 확보 등에 사용할 예정이다. 장 대표는 “새로운 로봇도 몇 분 만에 유용한 작업을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 게 회사의 목표”라고 말했다. 유지희 기자 keephee@hankyung.com

headlines.body: Nvidia has earned billions selling AI accelerators, but with the emergence of agentic AI, CPUs are going to play a considerably more significant role than before, which creates new opportunities for the company. Reuters reports that Nvidia has secured a major design win with its Vera CPUs with AI cloud provider Modal. According to Modal , preliminary evaluations showed that Vera could deliver twice the throughput of its existing AMD and Intel processors, although the company does not intend to cease using CPUs from its current suppliers. Go deeper with TH Premium: CPU (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Intel VP Robert Hallock sets Nova Lake expectations, teases return to Raptor Lake for DDR4 platforms CPU scaling with DLSS Intel's one-two punch plan in desktop CPUs is taking shape Benchmarking AMD's BC-250, offering Steam Machine-like performance at half the price AMD splits Zen 7 into three EPYC families for 2028 and starts selling server CPUs by the agent Modal provides cloud infrastructure that enables AI developers to deploy AI agents that can perform complex operations autonomously over extended periods. Such workloads require substantial CPU resources for software execution, data processing, and other tasks that cannot be efficiently handled by GPUs. Modal currently relies exclusively on AMD and Intel processors for these operations, but its tests indicate that Nvidia's new Vera CPUs could significantly improve performance in its specific workloads. Of course, since Vera is based on an Arm instruction set architecture, Modal's decision to adopt Vera will require substantial modifications to its software. Nevertheless, Modal believes that the potential performance improvements justify the additional engineering effort. The reported 2x throughput advantage is particularly interesting because agentic AI workloads can involve numerous independent tasks that compete for CPU cores, cache capacity, and memory bandwidth. However, Modal has not disclosed detailed benchmark configurations it used, specific AMD and Intel processor models, or performance-per-watt figures. Consequently, it remains unclear whether Vera's advantage is enabled by advantages of its Arm v9.2-based Olympus CPU cores that can decode and execute up to 10 instructions per cycle, its memory subsystem with 1.2 TB/s of bandwidth, or other architectural characteristics. Also note that tests compared Vera against currently available AMD and Intel processors rather than their upcoming generations that will compete against Vera in the coming years. Since Modal cannot port all of its software to Arm ISA overnight, the company will continue using x86 CPUs from AMD and Intel, according to Modal chief executive Erik Bernhardsson. Rather than sticking to one ISA for everything, Modal intends to operate a heterogeneous server fleet and select the most suitable processors for each workload. headlines.body: The Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC) ’s AI Factory Accelerator Programme, now in full operation following a pilot initiative, gives startups access to sovereign compute, technical support and training to support innovation across industries. Many of these companies are also members of the NVIDIA Inception program for cutting-edge startups — and as of today, access to some of the BSC AI Factory services are available through the NVIDIA Inception portal . NVIDIA Inception complements the BSC AI Factory Accelerator Programme by providing members with training through NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute open courses, business mentoring, venture capital connections and other resources. An upcoming extension of MareNostrum 5 — BSC’s public infrastructure serving scientific and technological innovation, powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing — will deliver supercomputing access through the BSC AI Factory and other AI Factories across Europe. BSC AI Factory is among Europe’s first AI factories and the first in Spain, and has delivered more than 800 services to private and public-sector clients since its April 2025 launch. stage1.korean_title: NVIDIA BlueField-4 STX Context Memory 버전, OCP 2026에서 공개

headlines.body: At OCP 2026, we saw the new NVIDIA BlueField-4 STX Server for Context Memory (CMX). Partners had been asking for this, and NVIDIA delivered. Onboard, we have a lower-cost design than the dual-Vera setup we saw previously. Let us take a look at the new board. NVIDIA BlueField-4 STX Server for CMX at OCP 2026 For context, this is the previously shown BlueField-4 DPU. That one, pictured below, is a dual Vera CPU setup, each with SOCAMM memory, plus four ConnectX-9 SuperNICs. NVIDIA calls this a DPU, but it is clearly more costly than a BlueField-1 or BlueField-3, which are much smaller and lower-power devices. For partners looking at building storage platforms, the below is more akin to a dual CPU server than a traditional DPU. At OCP 2026, multiple partners showed off the BlueField-4 STX server for context memory (CMX). Here is the much smaller card, which still uses high-density connectors for PCIe and system connectivity. NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPUs encompass both NVIDIA Grace and Vera CPU cores, but this one looks like a Vera package. That is a very substantial CPU. To be clear, this is not like the embedded-class CPUs that we typically have seen in DPUs previously. This is more like having a high-end single-socket server platform. Another interesting feature is that the boards at OCP 2026 are using SOCAMM memory, so these should be relatively easy to put either a heatsink or a liquid cooling block on top of it. Onboard, there is an M.2 slot. Usually these are for OS drives, but if you saw our recent Inside the Secretive AWS Networking Lab, the M.2 SSDs there are being used for log devices. This may seem like a small feature, but it means NVIDIA designed this less like a traditional motherboard replacement and more like something that is easy to assemble automatically. Something that may not immediately hit you if you are looking at photos is just the size of this board. A soldered CPU and LPDDR5X here, over traditional DDR5 DIMM slots, give NVIDIA a platform where the “motherboard” is roughly the size of an Intel DMR 16-channel socket or a 16-channel AMD EPYC Venice platform. Final Words This is just a neat platform. It almost feels like NVIDIA needs some brand between the Vera server line and the traditional BlueField DPU line. Something notable that we did not see on the boards shown at OCP 2026, or at least in our photos of them from various booths, is an NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNIC. We expected that, but did not see it on this board. For context memory platforms, a single Vera versus a dual Vera makes this a lower-cost platform, and that will likely help the STX/ CMX systems come to market as the price of NAND has been rising meaningfully over the past year.

headlines.body: 엔비디아와 마이크론이 장 마감 이후 시간외 거래에서 반등했다. 인공지능(AI) 투자 수익성에 대한 우려가 이어지는 가운데 엔비디아의 대규모 반도체 주문과 스페이스X의 실적 호조가 AI 산업의 성장 기대를 뒷받침했다. 미국 반도체주의 반등이 전날 급락한 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스 등 국내 반도체주에도 긍정적인 영향을 미칠지 주목된다. 20일(현지시각) 뉴욕증시에서 엔비디아는 전 거래일보다 0.29%, 마이크론은 0.98% 하락 마감했다. 필라델피아 반도체지수도 0.29% 내렸다. 전날 1.6% 상승하며 8거래일 연속 하락세에서 벗어났지만 하루 만에 다시 약세로 돌아섰다. 그러나 정규장 마감 이후 시간외 거래에서는 일부 반도체주가 상승 전환했다. 미국 동부시각 20일 오후 6시 10분(한국시각 21일 오전 7시 10분) 기준 엔비디아는 정규장 종가 대비 2.11%, AMD는 2.35%, 마이크론은 2.75%, 샌디스크는 3.01%, SK하이닉스 미국예탁증서(ADR)는 2.85% 각각 상승했다. 엔비디아의 AI 반도체 수요가 여전히 견조하다는 소식이 전해졌다. 로이터에 따르면 중국 바이트댄스와 알리바바, 텐센트는 엔비디아의 RTX PRO 5500 그래픽카드를 300만개 이상 주문했다. 주문액은 제품 정가 기준 350억달러(약 46조원)를 웃돈다. 미국의 대중국 반도체 수출 규제에도 중국 빅테크 기업들의 AI 연산 수요가 이어지고 있는 것이다. 다만 엔비디아는 생산능력의 한계로 주문량을 모두 공급할 수 있을지 확답하지 못한 것으로 전해졌다. 스페이스X의 실적 호조도 AI 산업의 성장 기대를 뒷받침했다. 스페이스X는 이날 정규장 마감 이후 3분기 매출 145억8000만달러, 순이익 44억달러를 기록했다고 밝혔다. 매출은 전년 동기 대비 161% 증가했고 순이익은 적자에서 흑자로 돌아섰다. 특히 AI 사업 매출은 76억달러로 전년 동기 대비 9배 이상 급증했다. 앤스로픽과 구글 등 외부 기업에 데이터센터 컴퓨팅 자원을 임대하는 사업이 성장을 이끌었다. AI 인프라 투자에 대한 우려가 커진 상황에서 관련 수요가 실제 매출 증가로 이어지고 있다는 점이 주목받았다. 마이크론은 생산 관련 불확실성도 안고 있다. 로이터에 따르면 마이크론 대만 사업장 노동조합은 성과급과 이익 배분을 둘러싼 갈등으로 22일 하루 파업을 예고했다. 파업이 실제 생산 차질로 이어질지는 불확실하지만 메모리 반도체 공급 측면에서 주목할 변수다. 미국의 반도체주가 시간외 거래에서 상승 전환하면서 이날 오전 국내 반도체주도 반등할 수 있을지 관심이 쏠린다. 삼성전자는 전날 4.13%, SK하이닉스는 6.81% 각각 급락했다. 엔비디아는 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 고대역폭메모리(HBM) 사업과 밀접하게 연결돼 있다. 마이크론은 두 회사와 글로벌 D램·HBM 시장에서 경쟁하는 기업이다. 엔비디아의 반도체 수요 확대와 미국 메모리주의 시간외 반등은 국내 반도체주 투자심리에 긍정적으로 작용할 수 있다. 최근 AI 투자 부담으로 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스가 약세를 보였던 만큼 미국 시장의 분위기 변화가 국내 증시에서도 매수세 유입으로 이어질지 주목된다. 에드워드존스의 앤젤로 쿠르카파스 투자전략가는 블룸버그에 “AI 수요가 둔화하고 있다는 징후는 없다”며 “AI 관련주가 일제히 상승하던 시기를 지나 기업의 경쟁력과 투자에 필요한 자금을 조달할 능력을 더욱 중시하는 방향으로 시장이 변화하고 있다”고 말했다. 윤승준 기자 sjyoon@chosunbiz.com

README:  # Cosmos3-H-Embodied-Nano ## Description Cosmos3-H-Embodied-Nano is [Cosmos3-Nano](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Cosmos3-Nano) (16B) post-trained for 50,000 iterations on the [Open-H-Embodiment](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/PhysicalAI-Robotics-Open-H-Embodiment) surgical robotics data (15 dataset families) jointly for **forward dynamics**, **inverse dynamics** and **policy**, with up to 16 past actions as clean conditioning. It is a single Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) that couples video, action, and text in one multimodal sequence. One model predicts robot actions and endoscopic video for dVRK-style and other surgical robots on 2.4 s clips (25 frames and 24 actions at 10 Hz): - **Forward dynamics:** first frame and actions → video. - **Inverse dynamics:** video → actions. - **Policy:** first frame, text (task instruction) and action history → actions and video. The three tasks are mixed 0.4 / 0.2 / 0.4 (forward dynamics / inverse dynamics / policy) during training. Because they are conditioning patterns of one shared model, a single checkpoint learns both directions of the surgical world–action relationship. It can be used directly in any of the three modes or fine-tuned further, for example on a single mode or on a new robot. README:  # Cosmos3-H-Dreams ## Description Cosmos3-H-Dreams is a real-time, action-conditioned surgical world model for the CMR Surgical Versius robotic system. It is fine-tuned on CMR Surgical Versius clinical cholecystectomy data and distilled into a causal, few-step student for interactive, streaming video generation. Given a single endoscopic camera frame, a short history of recent robot commands and a stream of future kinematic and control commands for both arms, the model generates the resulting endoscopic video autoregressively. The model is intended for surgical robotics policy evaluation in simulation, interactive (teleoperated) world-model exploration and synthetic data generation for robotic cholecystectomy, before transitioning to a physical system. Cosmos3-H-Dreams is the successor of Cosmos-H-Dreams ([arXiv:2608.24199](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24199)), which was based on Cosmos-Predict2.5. Cosmos3-H-Dreams is based on Cosmos3-H-Embodied-Nano, which is in turn based on the NVIDIA Cosmos3-Nano world foundation model for physical AI. README:  # NVIDIA Nemotron Parse v1.1 TC Overview NVIDIA Nemotron Parse v1.1 TC is designed to understand document semantics and extract text and tables elements with spatial grounding. Given an image, NVIDIA Nemotron Parse v1.1 TC produces structured annotations, including formatted text, bounding-boxes and the corresponding semantic classes, ordered according to the document's reading flow. It overcomes the shortcomings of traditional OCR technologies that struggle with complex document layouts with structural variability, and helps transform unstructured documents into actionable and machine-usable representations. This has several downstream benefits such as increasing the availability of training-data for Large Language Models (LLMs), improving the accuracy of extractor, curator, retriever and AI agentic applications, and enhancing document understanding pipelines. This model is ready for commercial use. The NVIDIA Nemotron Parse v1.1 TC version extends on top of [NVIDIA Nemotron Parse v1.1](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Parse-v1.1) and offers 20% speed improvement due to additional 4x vision token length compression (TC) on top of vision encoder representation.
